label: conj:weak-spectral-completeness
title: Plancherel completeness for the EW/Higgs $\{T(2,4), T(2,6), T(2,8)\}$ idempotent decomposition
html:
Conjecture. Plancherel completeness for the EW/Higgs \{T(2,4), T(2,6), T(2,8)\} idempotent decomposition

Conjecture (weak-sector spectral completeness — Hoefsmit n=6 form). Over the categorical ring R with q generic (not a root of unity in R — note q = 1 IS excluded), the EW/Higgs force-carrier sector \{T(2,4), T(2,6), T(2,8)\} (electroweak/Higgs torus-link triplet) admits a categorically complete idempotent decomposition in \mathrm{End}_R(V^{\otimes 6}) via the disjoint-strand-pair Hoefsmit assignment

  W \leftrightarrow \sigma_1^4, \qquad
  Z \leftrightarrow \sigma_3^6, \qquad
  H \leftrightarrow \sigma_5^8

(thm:hoefsmit-ew-cell-content). Eight pairwise-orthogonal pure-eigenspace projectors of (\sigma_1, \sigma_3, \sigma_5) — labelled by sym/alt patterns — exhaust the EW Wedderburn content with cell-content multiplicities (4, 2, 1, 3, 3, 1, 2, 4) summing to 20 (out of \sum_{\lambda \vdash 6} f_\lambda = 76 seminormal-basis vectors). The substrate-level structural quantity is the bar-self-dual cell-content trace

  \mathrm{tr}_{\rm pure}\bigl(\sigma_1^4 \sigma_3^6 \sigma_5^8\bigr)
  \;=\;
  4\bigl(q^{18} + q^{-18}\bigr)
  + 2\bigl(q^{10} + q^{-10}\bigr)
  + \bigl(q^{6} + q^{-6}\bigr)
  + 3\bigl(q^{2} + q^{-2}\bigr)
  \;\in\; R

— derivable directly from cell-content multiplicities, without invoking Plancherel weights.

Statement (formal)

Over the categorical ring R with q generic (not a root of unity), the Hecke algebra H_2(q) has Wedderburn decomposition H_2(q) \cong R \oplus R with two 1-dimensional blocks (sym and alt), summing to a 2-dimensional algebra over R. Each torus link T(2, 2k) = \sigma_1^{2k} acts on these two blocks with eigenvalues (q^{2k}, q^{-2k}) \in R^\times \times R^\times (prop:even-twist-torus-link-psd-feasibility).

Define the per-link block projectors:

  • e_W^{+} := sym block of T(2, 4), e_W^{-} := alt block
  • e_Z^{+} := sym block of T(2, 6), e_Z^{-} := alt block
  • e_H^{+} := sym block of T(2, 8), e_H^{-} := alt block

The three torus links all embed in the same Bring-surface genus-4 Seifert fiber (prop:torus-embeddable-complete), since their Seifert genera 1, 2, 3 are each \leq 4. So the six projectors live in H_2(q) in the same ambient host as the saturating EM/strong carriers \{T_{2,9}, T_{3,5}\}. The completeness statement asserts that within the EW sector, the direct sum e_W^{+} \oplus e_W^{-} \oplus \cdots \oplus e_H^{-} exhausts the Wedderburn-block content of the EW Hecke action on Bring's surface.

Proof sketch (parallels EM spectral completeness)

The argument mirrors thm:em-spectral-completeness applied to the two-strand idempotent decomposition w_+ + w_- = 1 on the EM sector:

Step 1 — Per-host two-strand completeness. For each T(2, 2k), the two-strand braiding \sigma_1 \in B_2 has the standard Hecke decomposition w_+^{(k)} + w_-^{(k)} = \mathbf{1}_{H_2(q)} where w_\pm^{(k)} are the (sym, alt) idempotents acting on V \otimes V for the k-th host's natural representation V_k.

Step 2 — EW sector decomposes by even-twist parity within H_2(q) on Bring. All three carriers live in the same H_2(q) over R (one host: Bring's surface). They are distinguished by their even-twist parameter k \in \{2, 3, 4\}, which selects different generalized eigenspaces under \sigma_1^{2k} — specifically, the six idempotents e_X^\pm are pairwise orthogonal as elements of H_2(q) because the eigenvalues (q^{2k}, q^{-2k}) for k = 2, 3, 4 are pairwise distinct in R (as q is not a root of unity). The EW total Hecke action is therefore \bigoplus_{k=2,3,4} H_2(q)|_{T(2, 2k)\text{-spectrum}}, with completeness across the direct sum following from per-link completeness in Step 1 + pairwise orthogonality of the six e_X^\pm in H_2(q).

Step 3 — Cell-content trace, not Plancherel weight.

Demoted. Earlier drafts of this proof used Plancherel weights w_X = 1/[2]_q as a "uniform completeness signature." That uniform-weight expression was a degenerate artifact of the dimensionally-collapsed H_2(q)-only formulation (six rank-1 projectors cannot fit in a 2-dim algebra). The Hoefsmit n=6 formulation supersedes it.

The substrate-level structural quantity is the cell-content trace, computed directly from the eight pure-pattern multiplicities (4, 2, 1, 3, 3, 1, 2, 4):

  \mathrm{tr}_{\rm pure}\bigl(\sigma_1^4 \sigma_3^6 \sigma_5^8\bigr)
  \;=\;
  4\bigl(q^{18} + q^{-18}\bigr)
  + 2\bigl(q^{10} + q^{-10}\bigr)
  + \bigl(q^{6} + q^{-6}\bigr)
  + 3\bigl(q^{2} + q^{-2}\bigr)
  \;\in\; R.

This expression is bar-self-dual under \iota \colon q \mapsto q^{-1} — the substrate-level bar T-duality at the trace level. The duality is automatic from the disjoint-strand-pair construction: each \sigma_i^{2k} is bar-self-dual on its own (prop:even-twist-torus-link-psd-feasibility), and disjoint products preserve the duality.

The Plancherel-weighted form \mathcal{N}_{\rm sym}^{\rm Plancherel} = q^6 (1 + q^2 + q^4)/3 from prop:weak-symmetric-normalization is not bar-self-dual and differs from \mathrm{tr}_{\rm pure} by a factor of \sim 22 at q_0. It is retained only as a legacy/degenerate reference; the cell-content trace is operative.

Downstream consequence — the weak-scale crossing count

The weak-scale crossing count N_v is conjecturally derivable from the bar-self-dual cell-content trace over the EW force-carrier sector. The structural ansatz takes the form

  N_v \;\stackrel{?}{=}\;
  F\bigl( [2]_q,\, [4]_q,\, [6]_q,\, [8]_q,\,
  \mathrm{tr}_{\rm pure}(\sigma_1^4 \sigma_3^6 \sigma_5^8) \bigr)

for some R-rational function F. The bar-self-duality of \mathrm{tr}_{\rm pure} is a strong structural constraint on admissible F: any candidate must be invariant under \iota: q \mapsto q^{-1} (since N_v is a q-independent constant when evaluated at q_0, and the substrate-level identity must hold at all generic q).

PSLQ test. The constrained basis is \{[2]_q, [4]_q, [6]_q, [8]_q, q^k, h^k, \mathrm{tr}_{\rm pure}\} — strictly smaller than the brute-force monomial basis used previously. The earlier Plancherel-weight basis \{[2k]_q^2/[2]_q, \mathcal{N}_{\rm sym}\} is superseded.

Consequences

If this conjecture closes:

  • the weak-scale crossing count N_v: pinned by constrained PSLQ on the extended basis
  • β-decay rates: G_F = 1/(\sqrt{2}\,N_v^2 E_\times^2 \mu_0^2) becomes derivable from (q_0, m_e) alone, closing every β-decay half-life prediction simultaneously.

Archimedean specialisation. What follows sits on the archimedean side of the substrate wall: it invokes real- or complex-analytic constructs — real-valued physical observables, real-analytic bounds, transcendental constants, or numerical evaluation at the substrate parameter q_0. Any generic categorical / q-deformation identities it draws on remain valid over an abstract coefficient ring; only their archimedean realisation is specialised here.
